text: Use a 15-second logging interval during normal collection. When battery charge is below 25 percent, use a 60-second interval.
Calibrate the air-flow sensor every 180 days. Set the reference flow to 1.5 liters per minute.
Store spare probes between 2 degrees Celsius and 8 degrees Celsius. A probe may remain in its transport case for at most 6 hours.
Move upload bundles to the archive after 30 days. Each bundle must be no larger than 250 megabytes.
Replace the inlet filter after 120 operating hours or every 4 weeks, whichever comes first.
Show a temperature warning at 35 degrees Celsius. Stop collection at 40 degrees Celsius.
Clean the probe connector with a dry cloth before each field visit.
Install the maintenance firmware no later than 2026-09-30.
